original_filter_prompt: Does this review express dissatisfaction? Review: {{ input.text }}
rewritten_filter_prompt:
Determine whether the following restaurant review expresses customer dissatisfaction — that is, whether it contains a complaint about the food (taste, cooking, quality, portion, temperature, freshness) or the service (staff attentiveness, behavior, speed, order accuracy).

Review: {{ input.text }}

Guidelines:
- Answer true if the review expresses ANY negative opinion or complaint, even if it also contains positive comments (mixed reviews count as dissatisfaction).
- Negative indicators include explicit dissatisfaction words (e.g., "disappointed", "worst", "bad", "not good", "poor", "rude", "overcooked", "undercooked", "not seasoned", "far away from real", "doesn't even taste good") and descriptions of problems with food or service (e.g., servers ignoring tables, wrong orders, long waits, unappetizing food).
- Answer false if the review is purely positive (only praise for food, service, atmosphere, drinks, or specials) or is neutral with no complaints.
- A single clear complaint is enough to answer true, even in an otherwise positive review.

Respond with a boolean: true if the review expresses dissatisfaction (a complaint), false if it does not.
